mil5.2.1:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, bhāsitam p' etaṃ Bhagavatā:
mil5.2.1:1.4: Ākankhamāno Ānanda sangho mam' accayena khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni samūhanatūti.
mil5.2.1:1.5: Kin-nu kho bhante Nāgasena khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni duppaññattāni udāhu avatthusmiṃ ajānitvā paññattāni, yaṃ Bhagavā attano accayena khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni samūhanāpeti.
mil5.2.1:1.7: Abhiññāyāham-bhikkhave dhammaṃ desemi, no anabhiññāyāti, tena hi: Ākankhamāno Ānanda sangho mam' accayena khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni samūhanatūti yaṃ vacanaṃ taṃ micchā.
mil5.2.1:1.9: Ākankhamāno Ānanda sangho mam' accayena khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni samūhanatūti, tena hi: Abhiññāyāham-bhikkhave dhammaṃ desemi, no anabhiññāyāti tam-pi vacanaṃ micchā.
mil5.2.1:1.10: Ayam-pi ubhatokoṭiko pañho saṇho sukhumo sunipuṇo gambhīro sugambhīro dunnijjhāpayo, so tavānuppatto, tattha te ñāṇabalavipphāraṃ dassehīti.
mil5.2.1:2.1: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā: Abhiññāyāham-bhikkhave dhammaṃ desemi, no anabhiññāyāti. Vinayapaṇṇattiyā pi evaṃ bhaṇitaṃ:
mil5.2.1:2.2: Ākankhamāno Ānanda sangho mam' accayena khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni samūhanatūti. Taṃ pana mahārāja Tathāgato bhikkhū vīmaṃsamāno āha:
mil5.2.1:2.3: ukkalissanti nu kho mama sāvakā mayā vissajjāpiyamānā mam' accayena khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni udāhu ādiyissantīti.
mil5.2.1:3.1: Yathā mahārāja cakkavattirājā putte evaṃ vadeyya: ayaṃ kho tātā mahājanapado sabbadisāsu sāgarapariyanto, dukkaro tātā tāvatakena balena dhāretuṃ, etha tumhe tātā mam' accayena paccante paccante dese pajahathāti;
mil5.2.1:3.2: api nu kho te mahārāja kumārā pitu accayena hatthagate janapade sabbe te paccante paccante dese muñceyyun-ti. -
mil5.2.1:3.3: Na hi bhante, rājāno bhante luddhatarā, kumārā rajjalobhena taduttariṃ diguṇa-tiguṇaṃ janapadaṃ parikaḍḍheyyuṃ, kim-pana te hatthagataṃ janapadaṃ muñceyyun-ti. -
mil5.2.1:3.4: Evam-eva kho mahārāja Tathāgato bhikkhū vīmaṃsamāno evam-āha:
mil5.2.1:3.5: Ākankhamāno Ānanda sangho mam' accayena khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni samūhanatūti.
mil5.2.1:3.6: Dukkhaparimuttiyā mahārāja Buddhaputtā dhammalobhena aññam-pi uttariṃ diyaḍḍhaṃ sikkhāpadasataṃ gopeyyuṃ, kim-pana pakatipaññattaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ muñceyyun-ti.
mil5.2.1:4.2: khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadānīti, etthāyaṃ jano sammūḷho vimatijāto adhikato saṃsayapakkhanno:
mil5.2.1:4.3: katamāni tāni khuddakāni sikkhāpadāni, katamāni anukhuddakāni sikkhāpadānīti.
mil5.2.1:4.4: Dukkaṭaṃ mahārāja khuddakaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ, dubbhāsitaṃ anukhuddakaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ, imāni dve khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni. Pubbakehi pi mahārāja mahāttherehi ettha vimati uppāditā, tehi pi ekajjhaṃ na kato Dhammasaṇṭhitipariyāye Bhagavatā eso pañho upadiṭṭho ti. -
